localChanges: After you end your turn, the map now says "Waiting for the other civilizations…" until your next turn is ready. Until then no unit blinks as if it could still move, and the End Turn button stays hidden. Before, the game looked ready but ignored your keys (#130).
The new turn now arrives all at once: the turn, year and treasury update together, before that turn's messages such as "Building complete" (#130).
The map keeps up better while the other civilizations move, instead of freezing and flashing in large games (closes #61).
